# Reflextry

> Free online cognitive training, reflex benchmarks, memory games, and esports warmup tools with millisecond precision.

Reflextry is a high-performance web platform featuring over 40 free interactive tools for testing and training visual reaction time, working memory, typing speed (WPM), click speed (CPS), mouse aim precision, and cognitive accuracy. Grounded in neuroscience and cognitive psychology principles.

## Reflex Tests

- [Reaction Time Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/reaction): Visual reaction time test measuring human response speed in milliseconds.
- [Audio Reaction Time Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/sound): Auditory reaction time benchmark for sound cue processing.
- [Choice Reaction Time](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/choice-reaction): Cognitive switching and multi-option response speed test.
- [Color Switch Reflex](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/color-switch): Rapid color-based stimulus-response mapping reflex test.
- [Directional Reflex Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/direction): Decision-making speed and keyboard reaction time test.
- [Flanker Task](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/flanker): Measures selective attention and distractor interference control.
- [Go / No-Go Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/go-no-go): Measures impulse control, inhibition speed, and motor response.
- [Grid Reaction Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/grid): Spatial reflex and visual target detection benchmark.
- [Multi-Stimulus Reaction](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/multi-stimulus): Choice reaction time with multiple simultaneous visual stimuli.
- [Peripheral Vision Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/peripheral): Wide-field visual awareness and side vision reaction benchmark.
- [Sequence Reaction Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/sequence-reaction): Sequential reaction and motor execution test.
- [Time Perception Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/time-perception): Measures internal clock precision and temporal estimation accuracy.
- [Whack-a-Mole Game](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/whack-a-mole): Fast-paced target reflex and hand-eye coordination game.

## Memory Tests

- [Sequence Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/sequence): Spatial working memory test based on the Corsi block-tapping paradigm.
- [Number Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/number): Digit span assessment measuring numerical short-term memory capacity.
- [Visual Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/visual): Spatial grid pattern recall and visual working memory benchmark.
- [Chimp Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/chimp-test): Working memory and spatial awareness benchmark inspired by Kyoto University primate studies.
- [Verbal Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/verbal-memory): Word recognition and verbal working memory capacity test.
- [Dual N-Back Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/n-back): Gold standard clinical test for working memory updating and fluid intelligence.
- [Object Tracking](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/object-tracking): Multi-object visual tracking and spatial attention assessment.
- [Color Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/color): Chromatic sequence recall and color working memory test.
- [Shape Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/shape): Geometric pattern recognition and visual memory recall.
- [Card Match](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/card-match): Visual pair-matching memory game testing visual association.
- [Word Recall](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/word-recall): Free recall verbal memory test assessing encoding and retrieval.
- [Symbol Memory](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/symbol): Abstract symbol pattern recognition and recall test.

## Speed Tests

- [CPS Click Speed Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/click): Clicks per second (CPS) test for 1s, 5s, 10s, and 60s intervals.
- [Typing Speed Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/typing): Typing speed test measuring Words Per Minute (WPM) and accuracy.
- [Mental Math Speed](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/math): Rapid mental arithmetic and numerical processing test.
- [Schulte Table](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/schulte-table): Classic visual search and peripheral focus grid benchmark.
- [Quick Sort](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/quick-sort): Rapid cognitive categorization and classification speed test.
- [Number Rush](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/number-rush): Sequential number identification and visual scanning benchmark.
- [Word Speed Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/words): Fast vocabulary typing and lexical recognition speed test.
- [Speed Grid](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/grid): Rapid grid target acquisition speed test.

## Accuracy Tests

- [Precision Click](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/precision-click): Micro-target mouse precision and spatial accuracy test.
- [Pattern Matching](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/pattern-matching): Visual matrix pattern recognition and comparison accuracy test.
- [Angle Estimation](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/angle-estimation): Visual geometry perception and angle estimation accuracy test.
- [Color Blindness Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/color-blindness): Farnsworth-Munsell style color vision discrimination screening.
- [Mental Rotation Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/mental-rotation): Shepard-Metzler 3D spatial visualization and rotation test.
- [Color Match Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/color-match): Stroop-style color-word interference and cognitive accuracy test.
- [Image Recognition](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/image-recognition): Rapid visual object classification under time pressure.
- [Data Entry Accuracy](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/data): High-speed data entry and typing precision test.

## Gaming & Aim Training

- [FPS Aim Trainer](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/aim): Browser 3D/2D FPS aim warmup and target practice tool.
- [Flick Shot Trainer](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/flick-shot): Mouse flick precision and rapid target acquisition trainer.
- [Target Tracking](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/target-tracking): Smooth mouse tracking trainer for competitive FPS gaming.
- [Stroop Drop](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/stroop-drop): Cognitive flexibility and color-word interference game.
- [Endless Dodge](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/endless-dodge): Reflex-based arcade obstacle avoidance game.
- [Rhythm Tap](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/rhythm-tap): Beat-synchronized reaction timing and rhythm game.
- [Gaming Reaction Test](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/reaction): Reaction benchmark tailored for esports players.

- [Training Programs](https://www.reflextry.com/training-programs): Structured cognitive training routines for gamers, students, and professionals.
- [Daily Challenges](https://www.reflextry.com/challenges): Daily cognitive challenge sets with XP progression.
- [Scientific Methodology](https://www.reflextry.com/methodology): Testing methodology, hardware latency compensation, and benchmark calculation details.
- [Science & Neuroscience](https://www.reflextry.com/science): Neuroplasticity, reaction time physiology, and cognitive psychology grounding.
- [Cognitive Science Blog](https://www.reflextry.com/blog): In-depth articles on cognitive training, reaction time optimization, and esports science.
